reviewSelection: Eight first-gate shared-chase/forward-eye views, five additional district chase views and five original catalog poses. All39 fixed cameras remain available; unrendered transforms are not pixel evidence.
notice: Frozen before/after source geometry. Static offline CPU rendering, approximate light/material response. No driver, vehicle, HUD, gameplay, GPU or performance claim. Normal shared-chase, forward driver-height and authored landmark-directed road-eye views are explicitly distinct.
baselineIdentity: Local sealed Workshop candidate; not published. Harvest source unchanged from last verified public dev commit.

catalogViews.name: harvest-overview
catalogViews.description: Complete original Amberwind Harvest circuit on connected grain terraces and orchard terrain, with both physical fork roads, drive-through barn, windmill, granary, silos, press and market. Exact emitted source geometry and approximate offline light.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/harvest-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: harvest-topdown
catalogViews.description: True overhead source geometry with both complete physical roads: the drive-through Barnyard Cut and broad Golden Contour. Real road width, split/merge throats, terraced terrain and planted orchard rows are retained.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/harvest-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: harvest-barn-passage
catalogViews.description: Real source barn passage from 2.1 m above the independently sampled Barnyard Cut approach. Open portals, actual structural posts, roof supports and through-road are unmodified; no removed wall, hidden mesh or gameplay claim.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/harvest-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: harvest-windmill-detail
catalogViews.description: Original windmill construction: masonry tower, actual static slatted sails, supported axle and grounded foundation. All source mesh batches remain visible; no animated machinery or gameplay claim.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/harvest-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: harvest-orchard-detail
catalogViews.description: Nearby lower-front perspective of the actual orchard press, including threaded static horizontal spindles, basket presses, supporting frame, stone trough and grounded foundation. All roof, posts and surrounding terrain remain unmodified; no hidden geometry.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/harvest-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit
